newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Soy basis down; corn, wheat steady.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Soy basis down; corn, wheat steady.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf soybean basis offers were down one cent per bushel for most positions, while corn and winter wheat values were largely unchanged, grain dealers said.
Demand was light at the Gulf for grains and soybeans, but movement in market channels also was light.

The tender lineup also was light for Gulf shipment. Pakistan was scheduled to tender late Tuesday, with results likely Wednesday, for 330,000 tonnes of U.S. white wheat, which should be shipped from the Pacific Northwest.
